_meta.note: Verbatim strings captured from the live product. Use these so the clone reads identically. Note the typographic apostrophe (U+2019) in several strings — Google is inconsistent about it, and both variants below are reproduced exactly as found.
_meta.branding: Do NOT reuse the Google Classroom wordmark or the green board/person logo. Everything below is functional UI copy.

consumerGate.title: Using Classroom at a school with students?
consumerGate.p1: If so, your school must sign up for a Google Workspace for Education account before you can use Classroom. Learn More
consumerGate.p2: Google Workspace for Education lets schools decide which Google services their students can use, and provides additional privacy and security protections that are important in a school setting. Students cannot use Google Classroom at a school with personal accounts.
